divergence: The whole event is missing — this is not a wrong key name or a wrong value. Two separable deltas. (a) MISCLASSIFICATION AT IMPORT: the adapter's own stated rule at `format-adapters.ts:634-635` — "A documented-but-unemitted event is a deferral, not an unknown name" — is not applied, purely because the event never reached `DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS`. A plugin author sees a typo-shaped warning where `MessageDisplay`/`TeammateIdle` get a routed reason. (b) THE EVENT IS UNIMPLEMENTED: no union member, no `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` row, no `EventPayloadMap` key, no payload carrying the documented `directory` and `source` fields, no matcher projection (so the documented matcher values `slash_command`/`register_repo_root` have nothing to match), and no emit at the only directory-add path we own. Note our path can only ever produce `source: "register_repo_root"`-equivalent semantics — programmatic, not a slash command — because the fork has no `/add-dir`. Stale as a side effect: the counts "30 documented events" (`hooks-runtime.ts:13`), "28 of the 30" (`format-adapters.ts:118`) and the same phrase in the test comment (`format-adapters.test.ts:3690`) are now wrong against both this page (31 in the `HookEvent` union) and the refreshed main reference.

blastRadius: Crosses a persistence boundary and a package boundary — a risk trigger in this repo. `AGENT_EVENTS` (derived from `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1`) is the accepted vocabulary for on-disk automations config: `packages/shared/src/automations/schemas.ts:197-202` builds `VALID_EVENTS` from it and `AutomationsConfigSchema` filters unknown event keys out of a parsed file (:205-215); `packages/shared/src/automations/hooks-config.ts:25,137` errors on an unknown event in a user/project hooks-config file; `packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-automations.ts:32,200,204` and `packages/shared/src/automations/automation-system.ts:50` gate on the same set. Widening is forward-compatible for existing files, but a config written with `DirectoryAdded` is silently filtered (schema) or errors (hooks-config) on an older build — that is the release-ordering risk. Type-enforced fan-out inside `packages/shared`: `PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENT_TO_AGENT_EVENT` (`hooks-automation.ts:372-403`) fails typecheck until updated; `PluginHookEventName` is imported by `hooks-automation.ts` and `plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts`. The event roster is ALSO hand-mirrored in the Pi subprocess package rather than imported: `packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.test.ts:16,87` and the fixture `packages/pi-agent-server/src/__tests__/extension-first/fixtures/behavior-corpus.json` enumerate event names as literals (verified: no `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` import anywhere under `packages/pi-agent-server/src`), so those lists drift silently unless updated. Direct test callers of the mapping: `packages/shared/src/plugins/__tests__/format-adapters.test.ts:3689-3706`. Two things it does NOT touch: the renderer's hand-maintained picker list `AGENT_EVENTS` (`apps/electron/src/renderer/components/automations/types.ts:33-59`) is a 13-event subset that already omits `CwdChanged`/`FileChanged`, so sibling parity needs no renderer change; and the identically-named `AgentEvent` in the Pi SDK message-type union is a different subsystem, unaffected.
userImpact: Today, concretely: a user installs a Claude plugin whose `hooks/hooks.json` declares a `DirectoryAdded` hook (the doc's own use case is installing dependencies for a repository added mid-session). The install succeeds, that hook is dropped from the plugin's capability list, and the install result carries the warning `External hook event "DirectoryAdded" is not mapped for claude compatibility.` — which reads as a typo in the plugin rather than a known Nessy gap, unlike `MessageDisplay`/`TeammateIdle` which import as routed deferrals. Since the Sources UI does not render plugin diagnostics, inside the desktop app the visible outcome is just a hook missing from the plugin; the wording surfaces through the marketplace/install RPC response and the agent-facing plugin-management tool result. A user hand-writing `DirectoryAdded` into a hooks config file gets `<source>: DirectoryAdded is not an agent lifecycle hook event`. Beyond the wording, nothing that hook declares would run even if the name were accepted: with no `/add-dir` command and no `register_repo_root` control request, the only mid-session directory add is another hook's `updatedPermissions.addDirectories` at session scope, which fires no event. Shipping a user-facing add-directory action is what would make the full gap surface.
